item.title: TANVI RATNA: With one war, Trump is breaking Middle East's old power structure
item.summary: U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran signal more than war — they represent a deliberate attempt to force a Middle East realignment, this analysis argues.

item.title: Marlins deliver walk-off win as team's teal jerseys make season debut
item.summary: The Miami Marlins' nostalgic teal jerseys made their season debut on Sunday and it came with a walk-off win against the Colorado Rockies.

item.title: Olena Zelenska warns abducted Ukranian kids may take ‘dozens of years’ to return, praises Melania Trump’s help
item.summary: Olena Zelenska credits Melania Trump's advocacy for spotlighting Ukraine's push to recover thousands of children reportedly taken by Russia since 2022.

item.title: Sen Ron Johnson says Senate is 'broken' and calls for ending the filibuster over DHS funding fight
item.summary: Sen. Ron Johnson says Republicans should end the Senate filibuster, blaming Democrats for the DHS funding deadlock and ongoing government shutdown.

item.title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to what to expect on DHS funding when the Senate meets Monday
item.summary: The Senate could end the DHS shutdown Monday via unanimous consent on the House bill, but a single objection from any senator could keep it frozen.

item.title: Van Hollen clashes with ABC host over what Democrats actually got from the DHS shutdown fight
item.summary: Sen. Chris Van Hollen sparred with ABC host Jon Karl over the 44-day DHS partial shutdown, denying that Democrats are holding up funding.

item.title: Golden Knights make major coaching shakeup as Stanley Cup Playoffs near
item.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights fired head coach Bruce Cassidy on Sunday and replaced him with John Tortorella with eight games left in the regular season.

item.title: Michigan routs Tennessee to win regional final, enter NCAA men's Final Four
item.summary: The Michigan Wolverines' 34-10 run helped propel them to a win over the Tennessee Volunteers and advane to the NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Final Four.

item.title: Cory Booker confronted with old clip of himself saying he loves Donald Trump
item.summary: Sen. Cory Booker was confronted with a 2016 clip saying "I love Donald Trump" during "Meet the Press" on Sunday, and said his Christian faith still guides him to love his enemies.

item.title: Vacation rental near Yosemite allegedly used to secretly record guests, 4,000 illegal files found
item.summary: A Madera County man faces felony charges after detectives allegedly found over 4,000 child sexual abuse files at a vacation rental near Yosemite.
